overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: entryFilter
params.description: New data entry filter for the enterable area

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets (or, if entryFilter is empty, removes) the current-process data-entry filter for the enterable field/variable designated by object and *.

constraints: Passing an empty string in entryFilter removes the current entry filter for the object(s).
Cannot be used with fields located in a subform's list form.
To reference a predefined entry filter created via the Tool Box, prefix its name with a vertical bar '|' in entryFilter.
